blocks.text: Open Invoices in the sidebar and press "New Invoice". The form has three stages: "Client & Dates", "Line Items" and "Options". Your work is saved as a draft while you go, and the page shows "Draft saved".

items: In "Client & Dates", search for your client, or type a new one and tick "Save this as a new client". Choose an "Issue Date" and a "Due Date". The due date must come after the issue date.

In "Line Items", press "Add Line Item" and fill in the description, quantity and unit price. Choose the "Currency" and, if they apply, a "Tax Rate (%)" and a "Discount". The subtotal and total update as you type.
In "Options", add "Notes for Client" and "Payment Terms". You can also switch on a late fee or make the invoice recurring.
Press "Preview PDF" to see it, then "Finalise" when it is right.

blocks.text: Finalising gives the invoice its number and freezes its PDF. A draft has no number yet and you can still change it. After that you can no longer edit the invoice.
"Start from Preset" on the Invoices page fills a new invoice from one you saved earlier.
